summary: Vodafone filed a Form 6-K carrying a Stock Exchange Announcement dated 30 October 2026 disclosing that Societe Generale S.A. completed its acquisition of a 50% shareholding in OXG Glasfaser Beteiligungs-GmbH, Vodafone's German fibre joint venture, from Geodesia Holding S.a r.l., following the 1 September 2026 announcement. No price, premium, financing terms or board recommendation were disclosed. The structure brings a committed funding partner supporting continued German fibre build-out while Vodafone retains strategic flexibility; watch governance, funding commitments, capex obligations and any future consolidation or exit options.
